A '''pumpkin''' was an orange, roundish fruit that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] harvested pumpkins and would carve faces in them for [[Halloween/Legends|Hallowe'en]].
